## 1. Setup

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(car)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

## 2. Data Import and Cohort Construction

```{r data-import}
data <- read.csv("data_pre_processed.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# age midpoint helper (used for descriptive summaries)
age_midpoint <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\u2013", "-")
  m <- str_match(x, "^(\\d{1,2})\\s*-\\s*(\\d{1,2})$")
  ifelse(is.na(m[, 1]), NA_real_, (as.numeric(m[, 2]) + as.numeric(m[, 3])) / 2)
}

# restrict to adults 18-30, exclude American Indian or Alaskan Native (n=3)
analytic_rounds <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Age %in% c("18-20", "21-25", "26-30", "21-30"),
    Ethnicity != "American Indian or Alaskan Native"
  )

# analytic subset with participant-level means
analytic_subset <- analytic_rounds |>
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, T_CEmax_mean, T_max_mean, Age, Ethnicity, Gender)

cat("N =", n_distinct(analytic_subset$SubjectID), "\n")
```

## 3. Round-Level Missingness (Table I)

```{r missingness}
round_vars <- c(
  "canthiMax1", "T_Max1",
  "canthiMax2", "T_Max2",
  "canthiMax3", "T_Max3",
  "canthiMax4", "T_Max4"
)

missing_counts <- sapply(analytic_rounds[round_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
total_rows <- nrow(analytic_rounds)

missing_rounds <- data.frame(
  Measurement = round_vars,
  Missing_obs = missing_counts,
  Percent = round(100 * missing_counts / total_rows, 2)
)

kable(missing_rounds, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Missing round-level observations (Table I)")
```

## 4. Within-Subject Repeatability

```{r within-subject-repeatability}
# T_CEmax: pooled within-subject SD
within_sd_ce <- analytic_rounds |>
  select(SubjectID, canthiMax1, canthiMax2, canthiMax3, canthiMax4) |>
  pivot_longer(-SubjectID, values_to = "temp", values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
  group_by(SubjectID) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  summarise(sd_within = sd(temp), .groups = "drop")

pooled_sd_ce <- sqrt(mean(within_sd_ce$sd_within^2))

# T_max: pooled within-subject SD
within_sd_max <- analytic_rounds |>
  select(SubjectID, T_Max1, T_Max2, T_Max3, T_Max4) |>
  pivot_longer(-SubjectID, values_to = "temp", values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
  group_by(SubjectID) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  summarise(sd_within = sd(temp), .groups = "drop")

pooled_sd_max <- sqrt(mean(within_sd_max$sd_within^2))

cat(sprintf("Pooled within-subject SD:\n  T_CEmax: %.2f °C\n  T_max:   %.2f °C\n",
            pooled_sd_ce, pooled_sd_max))
```

```{r descriptives}
desc_table <- analytic_subset |>
  group_by(Ethnicity) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    age_mean = mean(age_midpoint(Age), na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_max = mean(T_max_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_max = sd(T_max_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(desc_table, digits = 2, caption = "Descriptive statistics (Table II)")

cat(sprintf("\nOverall: age %.2f ± %.2f years; %d%% female\n",
            mean(age_midpoint(analytic_subset$Age), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(age_midpoint(analytic_subset$Age), na.rm = TRUE),
            round(100 * mean(analytic_subset$Gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE))))
```

## 6. Statistical Assumptions

```{r assumptions}
# --- T_CEmax ---
m1 <- aov(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
r1 <- residuals(m1)

shapiro_ce <- shapiro.test(r1)
bf_ce <- leveneTest(T_CEmax_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity),
                    data = analytic_subset, center = median)

# --- T_max ---
m2 <- aov(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
r2 <- residuals(m2)

shapiro_max <- shapiro.test(r2)
bf_max <- leveneTest(T_max_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity),
                     data = analytic_subset, center = median)

cat("T_CEmax assumptions:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Shapiro-Wilk: W = %.5f, p < 0.001\n", shapiro_ce$statistic))
cat(sprintf("  Brown-Forsythe: F(4,934) = %.2f, p = %.3f\n",
            bf_ce$`F value`[1], bf_ce$`Pr(>F)`[1]))

cat("\nT_max assumptions:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Shapiro-Wilk: W = %.5f, p < 0.001\n", shapiro_max$statistic))
cat(sprintf("  Brown-Forsythe: F(4,934) = %.2f, p = %.3f\n",
            bf_max$`F value`[1], bf_max$`Pr(>F)`[1]))

# Q-Q plots
pdf(file.path("figures", "qq_combined.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(r1, main = expression("Q-Q: " * T[CEmax])); qqline(r1)
qqnorm(r2, main = expression("Q-Q: " * T[max])); qqline(r2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()
```

## 7. Primary Analysis: One-Way ANOVA

```{r anova}
# Inner-canthus
model_ce <- aov(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
summary(model_ce)
eta_squared(model_ce)

# Full-face maximum
model_max <- aov(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
summary(model_max)
eta_squared(model_max)
```

### Figure 3: Monte Carlo Sensitivity

```{r figure-3}
set.seed(123)

sim_anova <- function(df, outcome, group = "Ethnicity",
                      sigmas = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30),
                      B = 5000, alpha = 0.001) {
  d0 <- df |> select(all_of(c(outcome, group))) |> drop_na()
  d0[[group]] <- factor(d0[[group]])

  base_means <- tapply(d0[[outcome]], d0[[group]], mean)
  base_order <- names(sort(base_means))

  out_list <- vector("list", length(sigmas))

  for (i in seq_along(sigmas)) {
    s <- sigmas[i]
    pvals <- numeric(B)
    etas <- numeric(B)
    same_order <- logical(B)

    for (b in seq_len(B)) {
      y_star <- d0[[outcome]] + rnorm(nrow(d0), mean = 0, sd = s)
      m <- aov(y_star ~ d0[[group]])
      sm <- summary(m)[[1]]
      pvals[b] <- sm[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
      ss_between <- sm[["Sum Sq"]][1]
      ss_total <- sum(sm[["Sum Sq"]], na.rm = TRUE)
      etas[b] <- ss_between / ss_total
      means_b <- tapply(y_star, d0[[group]], mean)
      same_order[b] <- identical(names(sort(means_b)), base_order)
    }

    out_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      outcome = outcome, sigma = s, B = B,
      p_sig = mean(pvals < alpha),
      eta2_med = median(etas),
      eta2_q05 = quantile(etas, 0.05),
      eta2_q95 = quantile(etas, 0.95),
      order_stable = mean(same_order)
    )
  }
  bind_rows(out_list)
}

sim_ce <- sim_anova(analytic_subset, outcome = "T_CEmax_mean")
sim_max <- sim_anova(analytic_subset, outcome = "T_max_mean")
sim_results <- bind_rows(sim_ce, sim_max)

kable(sim_results, digits = 3,
      caption = "Monte Carlo sensitivity results")

# relabel for plotting
sim_results <- sim_results |>
  mutate(outcome = case_match(outcome,
    "T_CEmax_mean" ~ "T[CEmax]",
    "T_max_mean" ~ "T[max]"
  ))

monte_carlo <- ggplot(sim_results,
    aes(x = sigma, y = eta2_med, group = outcome,
        color = outcome, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = eta2_q05, ymax = eta2_q95),
              alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, labeller = label_parsed) +
  labs(
    x = expression(sigma ~ "(\u00B0C)"),
    y = expression("Median " * eta^2 * " (5th-95th percentile)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3F6C8A", "#C05A46")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3F6C8A", "#C05A46")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88")
  )

ggsave(file.path("figures", "eta2_sensitivity.pdf"),
       plot = monte_carlo, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
monte_carlo
```

## 9. Model Evaluations
```{r}
# Make sure your filter now includes "21-30"
analytic_subset <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Age %in% c("18-20", "21-25", "26-30", "21-30"),
    Ethnicity != "American Indian or Alaskan Native"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, T_CEmax_mean, T_max_mean, Age, Ethnicity, Gender)

cat("N =", nrow(analytic_subset), "\n")

# T_CEmax assumptions
m1 <- aov(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
r1 <- residuals(m1)

sw1 <- shapiro.test(r1)
bf1 <- car::leveneTest(T_CEmax_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity),
                       data = analytic_subset, center = median)

cat(sprintf("T_CEmax assumptions:\n  Shapiro-Wilk: W = %.5f, p %s\n",
            sw1$statistic,
            ifelse(sw1$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                   sprintf("= %.3f", sw1$p.value))))
cat(sprintf("  Brown-Forsythe: F(%d,%d) = %.2f, p = %.3f\n",
            bf1$Df[1], bf1$Df[2], bf1$`F value`[1], bf1$`Pr(>F)`[1]))

# T_max assumptions
m2 <- aov(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
r2 <- residuals(m2)

sw2 <- shapiro.test(r2)
bf2 <- car::leveneTest(T_max_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity),
                       data = analytic_subset, center = median)

cat(sprintf("\nT_max assumptions:\n  Shapiro-Wilk: W = %.5f, p %s\n",
            sw2$statistic,
            ifelse(sw2$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                   sprintf("= %.3f", sw2$p.value))))
cat(sprintf("  Brown-Forsythe: F(%d,%d) = %.2f, p = %.3f\n",
            bf2$Df[1], bf2$Df[2], bf2$`F value`[1], bf2$`Pr(>F)`[1]))


# Kruskal–Wallis

# Inner-canthus
kw_ce <- kruskal.test(T_CEmax_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity), data = analytic_subset)
cat(sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis (T_CEmax): chi-squared = %.2f, df = %d, p = %.2e\n",
            kw_ce$statistic, kw_ce$parameter, kw_ce$p.value))

# Full-face maximum
kw_max <- kruskal.test(T_max_mean ~ factor(Ethnicity), data = analytic_subset)
cat(sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis (T_max):   chi-squared = %.2f, df = %d, p = %.2e\n",
            kw_max$statistic, kw_max$parameter, kw_max$p.value))

print(kw_ce)
print(kw_max)
```


## Code Appendix - Linear Regressions
```{r}
## 11. Supplementary: Covariate-Adjusted Linear Regressions

# Recode age bins to numeric midpoints for regression
analytic_subset <- analytic_subset |>
  mutate(
    age_mid = case_match(Age,
      "18-20" ~ 19,
      "21-25" ~ 23,
      "26-30" ~ 28,
      "21-30" ~ 25.5
    ),
    Gender = factor(Gender),
    Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity)
  )

# --- T_CEmax: unadjusted vs adjusted ---
lm_ce_unadj <- lm(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
lm_ce_adj   <- lm(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity + age_mid + Gender, data = analytic_subset)

cat("=== T_CEmax: Unadjusted ===\n")
summary(lm_ce_unadj)
cat("\n=== T_CEmax: Adjusted for age + gender ===\n")
summary(lm_ce_adj)

# Compare models
cat("\nANOVA: unadjusted vs adjusted (T_CEmax)\n")
anova(lm_ce_unadj, lm_ce_adj)

# --- T_max: unadjusted vs adjusted ---
lm_max_unadj <- lm(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset)
lm_max_adj   <- lm(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity + age_mid + Gender, data = analytic_subset)

cat("\n=== T_max: Unadjusted ===\n")
summary(lm_max_unadj)
cat("\n=== T_max: Adjusted for age + gender ===\n")
summary(lm_max_adj)

cat("\nANOVA: unadjusted vs adjusted (T_max)\n")
anova(lm_max_unadj, lm_max_adj)

# --- Effect size comparison ---
cat("\n=== Eta-squared comparison ===\n")
cat("T_CEmax unadjusted:\n")
eta_squared(lm_ce_unadj)
cat("T_CEmax adjusted:\n")
eta_squared(lm_ce_adj, partial = TRUE)
cat("T_max unadjusted:\n")
eta_squared(lm_max_unadj)
cat("T_max adjusted:\n")
eta_squared(lm_max_adj, partial = TRUE)
```

## Code Appendix - Complete-Cases Sensitivity Analysis
```{r}
# Restrict to participants with all four rounds observed for both outcomes
complete_cases <- analytic_rounds |>
  filter(
    !is.na(canthiMax1), !is.na(canthiMax2), !is.na(canthiMax3), !is.na(canthiMax4),
    !is.na(T_Max1),     !is.na(T_Max2),     !is.na(T_Max3),     !is.na(T_Max4)
  ) |>
  select(SubjectID, T_CEmax_mean, T_max_mean, Age, Ethnicity, Gender)

cat("Complete-cases N =", n_distinct(complete_cases$SubjectID),
    "vs full analytic cohort N =", n_distinct(analytic_subset$SubjectID), "\n")

# ANOVA on complete cases
m_ce_cc  <- aov(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = complete_cases)
m_max_cc <- aov(T_max_mean   ~ Ethnicity, data = complete_cases)

cat("\n=== T_CEmax: Complete cases ===\n"); summary(m_ce_cc);  eta_squared(m_ce_cc)
cat("\n=== T_max:   Complete cases ===\n"); summary(m_max_cc); eta_squared(m_max_cc)

# Compare eta-squared to full cohort
cat("\nEta-squared comparison (full vs complete cases):\n")
cat(sprintf("  T_CEmax: full = %.3f | complete = %.3f\n",
            eta_squared(aov(T_CEmax_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset))$Eta2,
            eta_squared(m_ce_cc)$Eta2))
cat(sprintf("  T_max:   full = %.3f | complete = %.3f\n",
            eta_squared(aov(T_max_mean ~ Ethnicity, data = analytic_subset))$Eta2,
            eta_squared(m_max_cc)$Eta2))
```
